title.narrative: RESOB Project (Water Resources in the SOcle of Burkina Faso)

description.narrative: The RESOB project aims to initiate changes in the practices of actors involved in groundwater detection in Burkina Faso. The project is carried out by Georeva Afrique, in a consortium with IRD and 2iE.The project has three main paths for change:– Axis 1: Revise the drilling implementation procedure.– Axis 2: Demonstrate the economic interest of changing practices.– Axis 3: Share knowledge by adopting an inclusive approach.The ultimate goal of the project is to enable Burkinabe people better access to drinking water.
